obligations.expected_behavior: Reject writes to installed `_bmad/**`, `.agents/skills/bmad-*/**`, and `.agents/skills/gds-*/**` paths.
forbidden_result: A write to an installed BMAD or GDS path is accepted.
Installed Skill files are modified under this scope.
obligations.observable_result: An attempted write to any protected installed BMAD/GDS path is deterministically rejected.
obligations.state_after: Installed BMAD/GDS path writes are blocked.
obligations.state_before: Installed BMAD/GDS path write protection is not independently enforced.
obligations.subject: Installed BMAD/GDS path boundary
obligations.trigger: A write to an installed BMAD/GDS path is proposed or attempted.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reject writes to Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and user-sandbox paths.
forbidden_result: A write to a protected Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, or user-sandbox path is accepted.
Service or sandbox files are modified under this scope.
obligations.observable_result: An attempted write to any protected Phase or sandbox path is deterministically rejected.
obligations.state_after: Protected Phase and sandbox path writes are blocked.
obligations.state_before: Phase, runtime, Hosted workspace, account, and user-sandbox write boundaries are not independently enforced.
obligations.subject: Phase and sandbox boundary
obligations.trigger: A write to a protected Phase or sandbox path is proposed or attempted.

obligations.expected_behavior: Require real defect-revealing tests before production behavior changes; for existing passing brownfield behavior, require truthful characterization and a distinct fault witness, and reject fabricated or post-hoc failure evidence.
forbidden_result: Production behavior changes proceed without prior real defect-revealing tests.
Fabricated or post-hoc RED evidence is accepted.
Existing passing behavior lacks truthful characterization or a distinct fault witness.
obligations.observable_result: A production change is accepted only when prior real defect-revealing testing and the required characterization or fault witness are present.
obligations.state_after: Production changes have valid prior defect-revealing test evidence.
obligations.state_before: Production-change test discipline and rejection of fabricated failure evidence are not independently enforced.
obligations.subject: Production-change test discipline
obligations.trigger: A production behavior change is prepared for evaluation.

obligations.expected_behavior: Require the detached positive Probe to pass and the detached negative Probe to fail for its declared defect and expected diagnostic category.
forbidden_result: The detached positive Probe fails while the capability is accepted.
The detached negative Probe passes or fails for an undeclared defect or unexpected diagnostic category.
Probe outcome claims are accepted without these oracle results.
obligations.observable_result: Independent Probe evidence records a passing positive Probe and a negative Probe failure matching its declared defect and expected diagnostic category.
obligations.state_after: The detached Probe oracle has passed for both positive and negative discrimination.
obligations.state_before: Detached Probe execution exists without an independently enforced positive-pass and declared-negative-failure oracle.
obligations.subject: Probe oracle outcomes
obligations.trigger: Detached Probe results are evaluated for validator discrimination.

obligations.expected_behavior: Require Stable to have verifiable provenance for existing supported behavior and require Candidate to contain the real change under evaluation.
forbidden_result: Stable is accepted without verifiable provenance for existing supported behavior.
Candidate is accepted without containing the real change under evaluation.
obligations.observable_result: Stable eligibility includes verifiable existing-behavior provenance and Candidate eligibility includes the evaluated real change.
obligations.state_after: Stable and Candidate eligibility requirements are verified before matrix execution.
obligations.state_before: Two-subject execution does not independently verify Stable provenance or Candidate change eligibility.
obligations.subject: Stable and Candidate eligibility
obligations.trigger: Stable and Candidate subjects are selected for Matrix execution.

obligations.expected_behavior: Require the six Matrix Cases to implement the named semantic distinctions: valid package, invalid package, historical compatibility, dirty baseline, knowledge read-set collision, and closed-policy architecture-index gap.
forbidden_result: A named Matrix Case is absent or replaced by an unlabeled semantic equivalent.
Case labels, hashes, or fixture distinctness are accepted without the required semantic distinction.
obligations.observable_result: The Matrix contains independently executed cases for all six required semantic distinctions.
obligations.state_after: All six required semantic Matrix Case types are present and verified.
obligations.state_before: Matrix distinctness is required without independently enforcing the six named semantic case types.
obligations.subject: Closed Matrix Case semantics
obligations.trigger: The replay Matrix is assembled or validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Permit `expected-difference` only when it is frozen for that case and all execution and evidence gates pass; it must not approve a regression.
forbidden_result: An unfrozen expected difference is accepted.
Expected-difference bypasses a missing execution or evidence gate.
A regression is approved through expected-difference.
obligations.observable_result: Expected-difference is accepted only for a pre-frozen case with complete execution and evidence gates and no regression approval.
obligations.state_after: Expected-difference results obey frozen-case and no-regression conditions.
obligations.state_before: The terminal category permits expected-difference without independently enforcing its case freeze and gating conditions.
obligations.subject: Expected-difference Matrix result
obligations.trigger: A Matrix result is classified as `expected-difference`.

obligations.expected_behavior: Bind each Consumer's actual interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
forbidden_result: A Consumer is considered covered without complete invocation bindings.
Declared Consumer metadata substitutes for actual interface, input, command, output, result, or dependency evidence.
obligations.observable_result: Every Consumer receipt contains attributable bindings for its interface, input, command, output, result, and dependencies.
obligations.state_after: All Consumer invocations are completely bound to their actual call data and dependencies.
obligations.state_before: Consumer calls and manifest reconciliation do not independently capture complete invocation bindings.
obligations.subject: Consumer invocation binding
obligations.trigger: A Consumer route is executed or its evidence is validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: For disable, invoke the Prior Route and reproduce Prior Route identity plus the Prior Behavior Baseline verdict and diagnostic category for every applicable fixture.
forbidden_result: Disable changes configuration without invoking the Prior Route.
Disable omits an applicable fixture.
Prior Route identity, verdict, or diagnostic category is not reproduced but disable succeeds.
obligations.observable_result: Each applicable disable fixture has a real Prior Route invocation whose identity, verdict, and diagnostic category match the Prior Behavior Baseline.
obligations.state_after: Disable restores and verifies Prior Route behavior for every applicable fixture.
obligations.state_before: Disable execution is recorded without an independently enforced per-fixture Prior Route postcondition.
obligations.subject: Disable transition postcondition
obligations.trigger: The enabled Candidate Route is disabled.

obligations.expected_behavior: Require each behavioral obligation to have its own observable fault witness and each non-behavioral obligation to have a deterministic violation witness.
forbidden_result: Multiple behavioral obligations share an aggregate-only witness.
A behavioral obligation lacks an observable fault witness.
A non-behavioral obligation lacks a deterministic violation witness.
obligations.observable_result: Exact Cover records the required independent witness type for every obligation.
obligations.state_after: Every obligation has its required independently decisive witness.
obligations.state_before: Exact Cover completeness does not independently enforce witness type and per-obligation independence.
obligations.subject: Independent obligation witnesses
obligations.trigger: Exact Cover witnesses are built or validated.

obligations.expected_behavior: Reject TC-E0 and TC-D2 through TC-D6 implementation, evaluation-set admission, quality-baseline creation, promotion, Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous Skill modification, SkillOS, learned ranking, percentage canaries, reinforcement learning, generalized governance, review-topology experiments, and cross-plan observability beyond TC-D1 evidence.
forbidden_result: Any excluded roadmap implementation or evaluation activity is accepted under TC-D1.
Seeds, packages, or Skill versions are promoted or admitted to an evaluation set.
Miner, Memory, Curator, autonomous modification, ranking, reinforcement learning, generalized governance, review-topology experiments, or cross-plan observability are introduced.
obligations.observable_result: Any attempt to perform the listed out-of-scope implementation, evaluation, promotion, or governance activity is deterministically rejected.
obligations.state_after: TC-D1 scope excludes all listed roadmap, promotion, baseline, autonomous, ranking, governance, and observability activities.
obligations.state_before: Only selected TC-D1 tree and Skill-input redesign exclusions are independently represented.
obligations.subject: TC-D1 scope exclusions
obligations.trigger: An excluded implementation, evaluation, promotion, or governance activity is proposed or attempted.
